## Professional summary

Experimental soft-matter and materials scientist with expertise in rheology, polymers, complex fluids, spectroscopy, thermal/mechanical characterization, fiber-forming materials, and structure–property relationships. Experienced in academic research, interdisciplinary collaboration, student training, instrument troubleshooting, and industry-facing materials problems.
